authorization.basis: User explicitly approved the shared-core architecture and local Delugi-to-Raptr phase; this manifest freezes technical contracts, not benchmark acceptance.

source_evidence.qualification: Frozen hashes identify the audited pre-extraction implementation, including existing local changes. Paths may later move; historical hashes must not be rewritten to hide extraction drift.

transport.profile_selection: Config.resource_profile; TransportSettings::for_committee; omitted resource_profile is legacy-1mib-v1
transport.mandatory_evidence_fit_check: Committee validates actual committee-dependent complete mandatory evidence; member guard alone is not an admitted committee-size guarantee.
transport.outstanding_reservation_scope: encoded framed bytes retained in deferred/outbox/window/staged states; reservations shared, not additive independent budgets
transport.full_queue: Runtime uses send_or_defer_accounted: retain exact signed FIFO frame; exhausted byte/deferred envelope or disconnected writer is an explicit terminal error. Lower-level send is fail-fast and requires caller handling.
transport.outbound_fairness: retry_deferred visits one FIFO head per peer per call, rotating first peer; a blocked peer does not block other peer retries.
transport.inbound_fairness_limitation: reader holds the shared received high-water mutex while waiting for mailbox count/bytes; inbound mailbox saturation can serialize reader admission. No independent per-peer inbound fairness guarantee.
transport.inbound_backpressure: Reserve unauthenticated body buffer before allocation; pause 1ms while unavailable. Authenticate complete frame, reserve mailbox payload bytes, enqueue before ACK; hold frame/body copies until reader iteration finishes.
transport.fifo_and_replay: One destination sequence across all layers; pipeline signed frames up to byte/item window; signed ACK reader independent. ACK retires oldest matching frame. Reconnect replays exact unacknowledged suffix before new frames. Duplicate sequence suppressed; gaps rejected. No sequence persistence across process restart.
transport.delivery_boundary: ACK means first successful authenticated mailbox enqueue (or duplicate already enqueued), not protocol acceptance, payload custody or durable storage.
transport.connection: TCP_NODELAY=true; one outgoing writer per remote peer; connect on queued work; fixed reconnect delay, no exponential backoff. Existing contexts and tcp-data-v1/tcp-ack-v1 signatures unchanged.
transport.accounting: successful stream writes including partial attempts and exact replay; disjoint payload/evidence_control/repair/transport_overhead sum to total; ACK, auth, length and bundle fields counted once as overhead; excludes TCP/IP headers and kernel retransmission. Scheduled/enqueued/ACKed logical counts remain separate.
transport.allocation_qualification: Queue reservations are not a complete heap/RSS bound: construction, decoding, body/payload copies, protocol state and output history may exist outside these counters.

actors_workers.ack_reader_threads: at most n-1; one per live outgoing connection, joined before replacement
actors_workers.ingress_threads: 0 or 1 per replica; independent of protocol thread
actors_workers.maximum_live_thread_topology_formula: 1 runtime + 1 control + 1 accept + (n-1) writers + at most (n-1) ACK readers + at most 64 incoming readers + at most 1 ingress; excludes external launcher/OS helpers
actors_workers.aggregate_cpu_or_rss_enforcement: none in this local Rust process; external inventory enforcement is a separate run-specific contract
actors_workers.shutdown: Transport stop flag, bounded I/O waits, connection shutdown and joins; ingress Drop/stop joins worker. Control shutdown is separate lifecycle.

runtime.handler: single protocol state owner; synchronous Node handler and effect serialization/drain before next logical receive; no async crypto/storage completion currently
runtime.bundle: default enabled, zero-wait per-effect-drain aggregation; preserve per-peer and cross-layer effect order; at most 32 canonical messages; payload size bounded by selected profile; oversized-for-envelope single remains original single frame
runtime.resource_budget: max_runtime_ms is configured; it is not a CPU budget or memory cap

timers.clock: Instant elapsed local monotonic milliseconds for protocol; application observation uses same process Instant microseconds
timers.wake_storage: BTreeSet of absolute millisecond deadlines; equal deadlines coalesce; all due Wake entries removed then one Node.tick(now)
timers.cancellation: no runtime cancellation API/generation token; core once guards and timer maps reject obsolete work; do not introduce new cancellation or equal-deadline ordering during extraction

protocol_policies.catch_up: original arm time + 3*bound_ms per exact endpoint
protocol_policies.progress_pacing: default release bound_ms from round entry, early release on protocol evidence; explicit override positive and <=bound_ms
protocol_policies.round_barrier: explicit comparison mode; separate from canonical outcome timer

timers.delivery: network/control turn can precede a due tick, and long synchronous handler can delay delivery; no hard timer scheduling guarantee
timers.bound_ms: run configuration, no new default chosen by this contract; initial approved local comparison uses 100ms with all native multipliers disclosed

mempool.full_queue: nonblocking try_send; explicit rejected request, no silent retry or admission rewrite
mempool.admission_atomicity: receipt mutex spans channel try_send and membership publication; consumer batching and output eligibility synchronize on same mutex
mempool.batch_ms: run setting in 1..1000; flush when size full or periodic boundary reached; no new service default
mempool.retained_observation_state: finite bitmaps in both modes; full detailed timing maps; Node log/payload history is still retained in compact mode

crypto.encoding: bincode1.3.3 fixed-int little-endian, reject trailing bytes, selected byte limit
crypto.hash: sha2 0.9.9 SHA-256; delugi/reference/ordering/v3-option-a domain and exact canonical preimages preserved
crypto.signatures: ed25519-dalek1.0.1 sign/verify_strict; 64-byte signatures; no aggregation/threshold provider

signature_cache.semantics: verified exact key/domain/preimage/signature cache; cryptography outside cache mutex

crypto.execution: synchronous on calling actor or transport thread; no separate pool
crypto.metering: optional, default disabled; separate protocol, transport-data/ACK, workload-manifest, observer-receipt, content-hash/proof/constructor domains; nested elapsed/CPU times must not be summed
crypto.backend_features: exact Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock hashed in source_evidence; bincode/ed25519/sha2 default Cargo features, serde derive enabled; no newly chosen provider

store.backend: in-memory BTreeMap and proof/index structures; no disk WAL/KV backend
store.current_api: synchronous validated insertion or error; there is no current generic durability request API
store.visible_definition: process-local BatchStore read can see validated inserted content
store.retention: payloads and metadata deliberately retained indefinitely; exact fork/custody indexes remain core-owned; no shared GC
store.custody: protocol-specific verified local payload holding, not process-crash durable custody
store.limits: per-batch payload and wire/profile limits; no aggregate retained-store byte cap. retained_payload_bytes is an observation counter.

output.order: pending_ordered FIFO; wait for every exact named suffix of head; expand producer then height within descriptor; never publish later descriptor ahead of unavailable head
output.batch_identity: (producer,height,record_digest); exact-batch repeats skipped by core; forks with distinct digest retained
output.application_identity: transaction id executes once; repeated ids deterministic no-ops even across distinct batches. Preserve this Delugi application convention; it is not a universal transport dedup rule. Distinct batch payloads retain raw occurrences.
output.invalid_application_payload: previously unseen authenticated batch stays in materialized batch log; malformed transaction vector is a deterministic no-op
output.append_boundary: observer mutex spans exact append and eligibility; full/compact common path; independent own batch_ready is not a prerequisite for admitted own output credit
output.metric: preassigned correct origin-local admission to first verified contiguous output on same monotonic clock; compact latency unavailable, common receipt counts retained
output.unbounded_history: executed/materialized/state indexes retained; do not claim output history is capped by transport profile

raptr_requirements.native_artifact_state: New observer/fixture/native runner incomplete and uncompiled at architecture checkpoint; no new native-ready artifact inferred.
raptr_requirements.actor: Preserve Protocol::run_ctx handler plus condition handler atomicity, including existing awaits under protocol mutex; retain Context/module event semantics. Do not force all workers behind one global actor.
raptr_requirements.timer: Native LocalTimerService BTreeMap<tokio::Instant,event>, schedule relative to local now, tick earliest; no cancellation in trait. Native protocol multipliers remain core-owned. Numeric port queue/worker/timer profiles must be audited and bound before shared label acceptance, not invented here.
raptr_requirements.crypto_and_payload: Retain native BCS/BLS types, signer/aggregation checks, full native identities; no simulator substitute or common cryptosuite normalization.
raptr_requirements.dissemination: Retain real QS prepare_block/available_prefix/notify_commit/check_payload policy and custody/repair/retention. dissemination/native.rs is sim-types-gated, not native Aptos QS.

output.ordering: core-reserved canonical sections; proof batches first then original subblock indices; preserve empty markers and repeated occurrences; async resolution keyed by reserved section, publish contiguous prefix only
output.extension_gate: for every legal prefix extension, expand(P1)+expandDelta(P2,P1)==expand(P2); segmentation/duplicate/reordering fixtures required before accepted implementation
output.contract_status: approved added application contract to be applied to reference observer and port; not a pre-existing VM execution guarantee; concrete pure fixture owned separately

unknown_until_adapter_audit: all native background workers and resource ownership
raptr_requirements.no_bypass_rule: Minimal Aptos compatibility may remain, but any native-only service use must be declared; intermediate facade is ineligible for shared-runtime native-policy label.

operation_correlation.meaning: Correlates an accepted async request to completion/failure/cancellation without replacing any protocol identity or changing signed bytes. At most one terminal service outcome per operation; shutdown abandonment explicitly recorded. Side effects with uncertain outcome report indeterminate, not cancelled-success.
operation_correlation.ordering: dependencies reference required operation completions; order of returned effect list is not storage/crypto completion order
operation_correlation.current_delugi: transport sequence/control request ids exist, but no generic cross-service operation ids yet; synchronous sections remain synchronous during extraction

storage_completions.Accepted: operation accepted under declared queue/resource budget; no visibility or write implied
storage_completions.Visible: declared local read sees value; no OS write implied
storage_completions.Written: backend completed its specified write operation, possibly only OS-buffered; no synchronization implied
storage_completions.Durable: declared synchronization completed under named persistence/failure model
storage_completions.unsupported: explicit error, never silently downgrade; current Delugi supports Visible only

runtime_reconciliation_required: accepted operations versus terminal/pending/abandoned outcomes by core and service
actual socket and child/worker inventory versus declared ownership
storage level counters versus actual backend calls and errors
crypto provider/domain calls including cache hits and background workers
aggregate whole-replica effective resources including all workers
prohibited_bypasses: hidden background workers or child process budgets
unbounded work masquerading as bounded queue capacity
planned_shared_contract.acceptance: Source hashes/configuration equality and one entry-point wrapper alone do not prove common-service use. Missing reconciliation, unknown native service use or unenforced resource claims fail the shared-runtime label; preserve diagnostics without promoting them.

gates.manifest_validation: structural/integrity validation only; not implementation or performance acceptance
gates.mechanical_delugi: before/after wire vectors, configuration identities, actor traces, timer/bundling variants, round4/silent leader+three anchors/forks/full proof/materialization/finite cohort preservation
gates.raptr: native-policy source mapping and legal-prefix output fixtures, then shared service routing and resource reconciliation
gates.local_acceptance: n4 healthy/empty/unfinished/silent-leader/missing-payload plus cleanup; zero injected delay and configured Delta100 initially, measured delta10 only with calibration
gates.later_scope: No later protocol port or cloud execution is authorized by this manifest
